note: Ported verbatim from spikes/s2-geometry-field/bench/f32-check.json (the fixture the S2 benchmark fed to bench/shaders.wgsl on a metal-3 adapter, agreeing to 4.08e-5 px). `expected` is f64 evaluation of the same arithmetic as the WGSL, so reproducing it proves the TypeScript field and the shipped WGSL compute the same function.
